title: Enrichment Configuration Guide for Hybrid Analysis

blocks.text: This configuration guide provides information on prerequisites and how to integrate Zscaler Deception with Hybrid Analysis to enhance the security events generated in the Zscaler Deception Admin Portal with additional context.

Hybrid Analysis detects and analyzes unknown threats using a file analysis approach. The analyzed data is processed and integrated into the malware analysis reports. You can send malware files to the Hybrid Analysis sandbox for testing and download reports for further analysis.
Before you configure the enrichment integration, ensure that you have:

blocks.item: Network connectivity from the Deception Admin Portal to the Hybrid Analysis server.
A valid Hybrid Analysis API key. To learn more, refer to the Hybrid Analysis documentation.

blocks.heading: Configuring the Enrichment Integration with Hybrid Analysis

blocks.text: To configure the enrichment integration with Hybrid Analysis:

blocks.item: Locate Hybrid Analysis in the table, and click the Edit icon under the Actions column.
The enrichment integration with Hybrid Analysis is enabled.

blocks.text: To test the integration, run an application file on a network decoy with Windows service enabled. When an alert is generated on the Investigate dashboard, send the evidence file to the Hybrid Analysis sandbox. After you send the evidence file to the sandbox, you can download the report for analysis.
